gbm_population_evidence.quote: A Randomised Controlled Phase II Trial of Temozolomide With or Without Cannabinoids in Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma
Histological diagnosis of MGMT promoter methylated, IDH wild type (WT) GBM with consistent local molecular pathology (repeat biopsy at recurrence is NOT required).

candidate_evidence.quote: The trial will randomise a target number of 120 patients on a 2:1 basis to receive either Nabiximols or Nabiximols-matched placebo, in combination with standard TMZ.

To establish whether the addition of cannabinoids (Nabiximols) to standard TMZ treatment improves overall survival time (OS) in MGMT methylated recurrent GBM compared to the addition of placebo to TMZ.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: First recurrence of GBM planned for systemic treatment as determined by local Multidisciplinary Team (MDT)

role_evidence.quote: Nabiximols up to 12 oromucosal sprays per day up to a maximum of 6 cycles; self titrated over days 1-14 in cycle 1.
to compare the cannabinoid Nabiximols with placebo in patients with recurrent MGMT methylated glioblastoma (GBM) treated with temozolomide (TMZ).

agents.drug_class_hint: cannabinoid (delta-9-tetrahydrocannabinol component of nabiximols/Sativex oromucosal spray; licensed for MS spasticity)

coder_notes: Nabiximols (Sativex) split into dronabinol + cannabidiol per C4; both coded experimental_combination as the two moieties of the single investigational product (an adjudicator may prefer experimental_monotherapy for the product as a whole; candidate status unaffected). Nabiximols-matched placebo in control arm not listed as an agent (placebo, no active moiety). Temozolomide given in both arms = soc_backbone. BRAF mutation is an exclusion (to exclude PXA-like pathology), coded eligibility, not candidate-matched; IDH-wildtype is a diagnostic criterion. No antitumour mechanism stated in record. Jazz Pharmaceuticals is a collaborator (structured field only).
